properties.name: Amaterasu
properties.description: Sun goddess and supreme deity of the Shinto pantheon. Ancestor of the Japanese imperial family. Her mirror is one of the three imperial regalia.

properties.name: Susanoo
properties.description: God of storms and the sea. Wild and impetuous. Banished from heaven for his behavior. Slew the eight-headed serpent Yamata no Orochi.

properties.name: Tsukuyomi
properties.description: Moon god, born from Izanagi's right eye. Banished from Amaterasu's presence for killing the food goddess Uke Mochi. Night exists because of their estrangement.

properties.name: Inari
properties.description: Kami of rice, fertility, and prosperity. Served by fox (kitsune) messengers. One of Japan's most popular deities â€” over 30,000 shrines.

properties.name: Izanagi
properties.description: Creator god who with Izanami formed the Japanese islands. Father of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo. His purification created the three noble children.

properties.name: Izanami
properties.description: Creator goddess who died giving birth to fire. Became queen of Yomi (underworld). Her decay horrified Izanagi, binding her to death's realm.

properties.name: Raijin
properties.description: God of thunder and lightning. Beats his ring of drums to create thunder. Often depicted alongside FÅ«jin at temple gates.

properties.name: Hachiman
properties.description: God of war and divine protector of Japan. Patron of the samurai class. Deified Emperor Ojin. Over 25,000 shrines across Japan.
